title: Qualcomm in talks to provide custom chip-design services to ByteDance, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，高通正在洽谈向字节跳动提供定制芯片设计服务
summary: Qualcomm is in talks to provide chip-design services to China's ByteDance, four people familiar with the matter said, as the U.S. company seeks ‌to reduce dependence on the smartphone market, its biggest revenue source.
summary_zh: 四位知情人士表示，高通正在就向中国字节跳动提供芯片设计服务进行谈判，因为这家美国公司寻求减少对其最大收入来源智能手机市场的依赖。

title: Alphabet to replace Verizon in Dow Jones reshuffle, shares rise
title_zh: Alphabet 将在道琼斯洗牌中取代 Verizon，股价上涨
summary: Alphabet was poised to open higher on Wednesday after the tech giant was tapped to join the Dow Jones Industrial Average, replacing Verizon.
summary_zh: 在科技巨头 Alphabet 被任命取代 Verizon 加入道琼斯工业平均指数后，该公司周三有望高开。

title: Walmart's Flipkart plans India quick commerce expansion ahead of IPO
title_zh: 沃尔玛旗下 Flipkart 计划在 IPO 之前在印度快速扩张商业业务
summary: By Dhwani Pandya MUMBAI, June 24 (Reuters) - Walmart's Flipkart is speeding up expansion of its "quick commerce" business in India, with plans to add 500 more neighbourhood warehouses across the
summary_zh: 路透孟买 6 月 24 日 - 沃尔玛旗下 Flipkart 正在加快其在印度“快速商务”业务的扩张，计划在印度各地增设 500 个社区仓库。

title: Wall Street ends lower as AI spending concerns mount
title_zh: 随着人工智能支出担忧加剧，华尔街收低
summary: STORY: A down day on Wall Street Tuesday saw the Dow edge lower, while the S&P 500 tumbled nearly one-and-a-half percent and the tech-heavy Nasdaq plummeted about 2.2%.Jitters over debt-funded AI spending led to sharp losses in semiconductor and other Big Tech tech stocks.:: M...
summary_zh: 故事：周二华尔街股市下跌，道琼斯指数小幅走低，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌近 1.5%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数暴跌约 2.2%。对债务融资的人工智能支出的不安导致半导体和其他大型科技股大幅下跌。:: M...

title: Prime Day is underway: Here are all the ways you can save
title_zh: Prime Day 正在进行中：以下是您可以节省的所有方法
summary: Competitor sales, discount stacking, and AI tools are making it worthwhile for shoppers to look past the sale prices this Prime Day.
summary_zh: 竞争对手的销售、折扣叠加和人工智能工具让购物者在这个 Prime Day 上忽略促销价格是值得的。

title: Google's YouTube settles case over social media harm to children
title_zh: 谷歌旗下 YouTube 就社交媒体伤害儿童一案达成和解
summary: Google's YouTube has settled a lawsuit brought by a minor who claimed the platform damaged his mental health, his lawyers said Tuesday, ahead of a second California trial over social media's role in the youth ‌mental health crisis.
summary_zh: 谷歌的 YouTube 已经和解了一名未成年人提起的诉讼，该未成年人声称该平台损害了他的心理健康，他的律师周二表示，在加利福尼亚州就社交媒体在青少年心理健康危机中的作用进行第二次审判之前。

summary_zh: 作者：Amanda Cooper 和 Chibuike Oguh 纽约/伦敦，6 月 23 日（路透社）——周二，全球股市下跌，因投资者继续抛售科技股和半导体股而下跌。
